exampleAnswers.title: Solving for an Unknown Given Two Perpendicular Vectors

question.text: What is the value of $x$ given that $\mathbf{a} = \begin{bmatrix} 2x \\ -1 \\ 5 \end{bmatrix} , \, \mathbf{b} = \begin{bmatrix} -3 \\ 4 \\ x \end{bmatrix}$ and $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}?$
question.explanation:
We know that $\mathbf{a} \perp \mathbf{b}$ ($\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are perpendicular) if and only if $\mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} = 0.$

Computing the dot product, we have

\begin{align*} \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} &= a_x \cdot b_x + a_y \cdot b_y + a_z \cdot b_z \\[3pt] &= 2x \cdot (-3) + (-1) \cdot 4 + 5 \cdot x \\[3pt] &= -6x - 4 + 5x \\[3pt] &= -x-4. \end{align*}

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we obtain:

\begin{align*} \mathbf{a} \cdot \mathbf{b} &= 0\\[3pt] -x-4 &= 0 \\[3pt] x &= -4 \end{align*}

example.title: Solving for an Unknown Given Two Perpendicular Vectors

question.text: Let $\mathbf{u} = \begin{bmatrix} a \\ -2 \end{bmatrix}$ and $\mathbf{v} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 4 \end{bmatrix}.$ Given that $\mathbf{u} \perp \mathbf{v}$, find the value of $a.$
question.explanation:
We know that $\mathbf{u} \perp \mathbf{v}$ ($\mathbf{a}$ and $\mathbf{b}$ are perpendicular) if and only if $\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = 0.$

Computing the dot product, we have

\begin{align*} \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} &= u_x \cdot v_x + u_y \cdot v_y \\[3pt] &= a \cdot 1 + (-2) \cdot 4 \\[3pt] &= a - 8. \end{align*}

Setting the dot product equal to $0,$ we obtain:

\begin{align*} \mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} &= 0\\[3pt] a - 8 &= 0 \\[3pt] a &= 8 \end{align*}
